-- @formatter:off SELECT s.*, g.*, reg.registeredClassTypes AS classType, pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last AS phone FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_parent pa ON s.student_id = pa.student_id JOIN erp_user u ON u.user_code = #{userCode} OUTER APPLY ( SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + cc.class_type FROM erp_time_table_assign tta JOIN erp_time_table t ON tta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE tta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS registeredClassTypes ) reg WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND s.status_key ='ACTIVE' AND (ta.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR ta.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode}) AND ( reg.registeredClassTypes IS NULL OR ( -- 한자만 담당 (u.is_han = 'true' AND u.is_book = 'false' AND (ta.han_state = 0 OR reg.registeredClassTypes NOT LIKE '%1%')) OR -- 독서만 담당 (u.is_han = 'false' AND u.is_book = 'true' AND (ta.book_state = 0 OR reg.registeredClassTypes NOT LIKE '%2%')) OR -- 둘 다 담당: 둘 다 없거나 하나만 있어야 함 (u.is_han = 'true' AND u.is_book = 'true' AND NOT (reg.registeredClassTypes LIKE '%1%' AND reg.registeredClassTypes LIKE '%2%')) OR -- 둘 다 안 담당 (u.is_han = 'false' AND u.is_book = 'false') ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ta.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR ta.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.student_name; -- @formatter:on

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.status_key AS statusKey, sc.status_name AS statusName, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass, p.parent_tel_first + p.parent_tel_middle + p.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone, p.relation_key AS parentRelation, s.school AS school, s.grade_key AS gradeKey, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, s.gender AS genderKey, s.birth AS birth, s.billing_phone AS billingPhone, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail from erp_student s LEFT JOIN erp_status_code sc ON s.status_key = sc.status_key JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON s.grade_key = gc.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key JOIN erp_parent p ON s.student_id = p.student_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT ta.han_state AS hanState, ta.book_state AS bookState, ta.han_material_fee AS hanMaterialPrice, ta.book_material_fee AS bookMaterialPrice, ta.assign_han_class AS hanClassKey, ta.assign_book_class AS bookClassKey, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, hc.class_name AS hanClassName, bc.class_name AS bookClassName, hf.fee AS hanFee, bf.fee AS bookFee, ta.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, ta.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate FROM erp_teacher_assign ta JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_class_fee_map_copy hf ON ta.assign_han_class = hf.class_key AND s.center_code = hf.center_code AND ((s.is_hoho = 1 AND hf.category = 'hoho') OR (s.is_hoho = 0 AND hf.category <> 'hoho')) LEFT JOIN erp_class_fee_map_copy bf ON ta.assign_book_class = bf.class_key AND s.center_code = bf.center_code AND ((s.is_hoho = 1 AND bf.category = 'hoho') OR (s.is_hoho = 0 AND bf.category <> 'hoho')) WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, CASE WHEN s.app_token IS NOT NULL AND s.app_token != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasApp, sc.status_name AS statusName, COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(v) FROM (VALUES (eta.entry_book_date), (eta.entry_han_date)) AS value (v) WHERE v IS NOT NULL), FORMAT(s.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') ) AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName, s.app_id AS appId, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass, CASE WHEN sib.student_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isSibling
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN erp_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN erp_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_user hu on ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu on ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign eta on s.student_id = eta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc on eta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc on eta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_sibling sib ON sib.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND ISNULL(s.status_key, '') < > 'WITHDRAWN' AND (#{userCode} = 'all' OR hu.user_code = #{userCode} OR bu.user_code = #{userCode})

AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS hanClass,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON cc.class_key = t.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND cc.class_type = 2 AND t.yy = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyy') AND t.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookClass, p.parent_tel_first + p.parent_tel_middle + p.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN ERP_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code LEFT JOIN erp_parent p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
LEFT JOIN ERP_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key
t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.student_id as studentId, s.student_name as studentName, s.app_password as password, c.center_code as centerCode, c.center_name as centerName, s.grade_key as gradeKey, s.app_id as appId, s.app_password as appPassword, s.grade_key as ihak FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code WHERE s.app_id = #{appId}

SELECT s.student_id as stuid, s.student_name as name, c.center_code as cid, c.center_name as cname, 'Y' as brotherGb, ss.sibling_key as sibling, s.grade_key as hak, ISNULL(s.profile_img, '1') as profileimg, s.app_id as appId FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code JOIN erp_sibling ss ON s.student_id = ss.student_id WHERE ss.sibling_key = #{siblingKey}

SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CAST(cc.class_type AS INT)) = 2 THEN s.grade_key ELSE '00' END AS book_code FROM erp_time_table t inner JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = ta.student_id inner JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND cc.class_type IN ('1', '2') GROUP BY s.grade_key

SELECT TOP 1 sa.attendance_date AS ymd, CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 1 THEN '일요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 2 THEN '월요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 3 THEN '화요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 4 THEN '수요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 5 THEN '목요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 6 THEN '금요일' WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, sa.attendance_date) = 7 THEN '토요일' END AS dayname, REPLACE(sa.in_time, ':', '') AS stime, REPLACE(ISNULL(sa.out_time, ''), ':', '') AS etime, '수업' AS gb FROM erp_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} AND sa.in_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa.attendance_date DESC, sa.check_in_updated_at DESC

SELECT COALESCE(e.ym, i.ym, mi.ym, mo.ym) AS ym, ISNULL(e.cnt, 0) AS entry_count, ISNULL(i.cnt, 0) AS inactive_count, ISNULL(mi.cnt, 0) AS move_in_count, ISNULL(mo.cnt, 0) AS move_out_count FROM ( -- 입회 SELECT substring(entry_date, 1, 7) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt FROM (SELECT student_id, entry_han_date AS entry_date FROM erp_teacher_assign WHERE (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR assign_han_teacher = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(entry_han_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} UNION ALL SELECT student_id, entry_book_date FROM erp_teacher_assign WHERE (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR assign_book_teacher = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(entry_book_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm}) t WHERE entry_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY substring(entry_date, 1, 7)) e FULL OUTER JOIN ( -- 탈퇴 SELECT substring(inactive_date, 1, 7) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt FROM (SELECT student_id, inactive_han_date AS inactive_date FROM erp_teacher_assign WHERE (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR inactive_han_teacher = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(inactive_han_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} UNION ALL SELECT student_id, inactive_book_date FROM erp_teacher_assign WHERE (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR inactive_book_teacher = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(inactive_book_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm}) t WHERE inactive_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY substring(inactive_date, 1, 7)) i ON e.ym = i.ym FULL OUTER JOIN ( -- 전입 SELECT substring(move_at, 1, 7) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt FROM erp_student_transfer_history WHERE (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR to_user_code = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(move_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} AND (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR from_user_code != #{teacherCode}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_student_transfer_history t2 WHERE t2.student_id = erp_student_transfer_history.student_id AND (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR t2.from_user_code = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(t2.move_at, 1, 7) = substring(erp_student_transfer_history.move_at, 1, 7)) GROUP BY substring(move_at, 1, 7)) mi ON COALESCE(e.ym, i.ym) = mi.ym FULL OUTER JOIN ( -- 전출 SELECT substring(move_at, 1, 7) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt FROM erp_student_transfer_history WHERE (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR from_user_code = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(move_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} AND (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR to_user_code != #{teacherCode}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_student_transfer_history t2 WHERE t2.student_id = erp_student_transfer_history.student_id AND (#{teacherCode} = 'all' OR t2.to_user_code = #{teacherCode}) AND substring(t2.move_at, 1, 7) = substring(erp_student_transfer_history.move_at, 1, 7)) GROUP BY substring(move_at, 1, 7)) mo ON COALESCE(e.ym, i.ym, mi.ym) = mo.ym ORDER BY COALESCE(e.ym, i.ym, mi.ym, mo.ym)
EXEC sp_cancel_join_student #{studentId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.student_id) FROM erp_teacher_assign t JOIN erp_student es ON t.student_id = es.student_id WHERE es.center_code = #{centerCode} AND ( ((#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR t.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode}) AND SUBSTRING(t.entry_han_date, 1, 7) = #{ym}) OR ((#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR t.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode}) AND SUBSTRING(t.entry_book_date, 1, 7) = #{ym}) )) AS joinCount,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wl.student_id) FROM erp_student_withdraw_log wl WHERE wl.center_code = #{centerCode} AND wl.withdraw_date IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRING(wl.withdraw_date, 1, 7) = #{ym} AND ( #{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR (wl.log_type = 'han' AND wl.before_han_teacher = #{userCode}) OR (wl.log_type = 'book' AND wl.before_book_teacher = #{userCode}) )) AS withdrawCount,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM erp_student_transfer_history WHERE (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR to_user_code = #{userCode}) AND center_code = #{centerCode} AND SUBSTRING(move_at, 1, 7) = #{ym}) AS transferInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM erp_student_transfer_history WHERE (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR from_user_code = #{userCode}) AND center_code = #{centerCode} AND SUBSTRING(move_at, 1, 7) = #{ym}) AS transferOutCount,
0 AS graduateCount

SELECT es.student_id AS studentId, es.student_name AS studentName, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, CASE WHEN t.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' AND t.assign_han_teacher IS NOT NULL) THEN (SELECT c.class_name FROM erp_class_code c WHERE c.class_key = t.assign_han_class) WHEN t.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode} OR (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' AND t.assign_book_teacher IS NOT NULL) THEN (SELECT c.class_name FROM erp_class_code c WHERE c.class_key = t.assign_book_class) END AS className, CASE WHEN t.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' AND t.assign_han_teacher IS NOT NULL) THEN (SELECT u.user_name FROM erp_user u WHERE u.user_code = t.assign_han_teacher) WHEN t.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode} OR (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' AND t.assign_book_teacher IS NOT NULL) THEN (SELECT u.user_name FROM erp_user u WHERE u.user_code = t.assign_book_teacher) END AS teacherName, CASE WHEN t.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} OR (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' AND t.assign_han_teacher IS NOT NULL) THEN t.entry_han_date WHEN t.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode} OR (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' AND t.assign_book_teacher IS NOT NULL) THEN t.entry_book_date END AS joinDate FROM erp_teacher_assign t JOIN erp_student es ON t.student_id = es.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON es.grade_key = gc.grade_key WHERE es.center_code = #{centerCode} AND (((#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR t.assign_han_teacher = #{userCode}) AND SUBSTRING(t.entry_han_date, 1, 7) = #{ym}) OR ((#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR t.assign_book_teacher = #{userCode}) AND SUBSTRING(t.entry_book_date, 1, 7) = #{ym})) ORDER BY es.student_name

SELECT es.student_id AS studentId, es.student_name AS studentName, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, CASE WHEN wl.log_type = 'han' THEN cc_han.class_name ELSE cc_book.class_name END AS className, CASE WHEN wl.log_type = 'han' THEN u_han.user_name ELSE u_book.user_name END AS teacherName, CASE WHEN wl.log_type = 'han' THEN wl.before_entry_han_date ELSE wl.before_entry_book_date END AS joinDate, wl.withdraw_date AS withdrawDate, DATEDIFF(MONTH, CASE WHEN wl.log_type = 'han' THEN wl.before_entry_han_date ELSE wl.before_entry_book_date END, wl.withdraw_date ) AS attendMonths, wl.withdraw_reason AS reason FROM erp_student_withdraw_log wl JOIN erp_student es ON wl.student_id = es.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON es.grade_key = gc.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc_han ON cc_han.class_key = wl.before_han_class LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc_book ON cc_book.class_key = wl.before_book_class LEFT JOIN erp_user u_han ON u_han.user_code = wl.before_han_teacher LEFT JOIN erp_user u_book ON u_book.user_code = wl.before_book_teacher WHERE wl.center_code = #{centerCode} AND wl.withdraw_date IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRING(wl.withdraw_date, 1, 7) = #{ym} AND ( #{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR (wl.log_type = 'han' AND wl.before_han_teacher = #{userCode}) OR (wl.log_type = 'book' AND wl.before_book_teacher = #{userCode}) ) ORDER BY es.student_name

SELECT es.student_id AS studentId, es.student_name AS studentName, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, (SELECT c.class_name FROM erp_class_code c WHERE c.class_key = th.class_key) AS className, CASE WHEN t.assign_han_teacher = th.to_user_code THEN t.entry_han_date WHEN t.assign_book_teacher = th.to_user_code THEN t.entry_book_date END AS joinDate, (SELECT u.user_name FROM erp_user u WHERE u.user_code = th.to_user_code) AS transferInTeacher, (SELECT u.user_name FROM erp_user u WHERE u.user_code = th.from_user_code) AS transferOutTeacher, th.move_at AS transferDate, th.transfer_reason AS reason FROM erp_student_transfer_history th JOIN erp_student es ON th.student_id = es.student_id JOIN erp_teacher_assign t ON es.student_id = t.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON es.grade_key = gc.grade_key WHERE (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR th.to_user_code = #{userCode}) AND th.center_code = #{centerCode} AND SUBSTRING(th.move_at, 1, 7) = #{ym} ORDER BY es.student_name

SELECT es.student_id AS studentId, es.student_name AS studentName, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, (SELECT c.class_name FROM erp_class_code c WHERE c.class_key = th.class_key) AS className, CASE WHEN t.assign_han_teacher = th.to_user_code THEN t.entry_han_date WHEN t.assign_book_teacher = th.to_user_code THEN t.entry_book_date END AS joinDate, (SELECT u.user_name FROM erp_user u WHERE u.user_code = th.to_user_code) AS transferInTeacher, (SELECT u.user_name FROM erp_user u WHERE u.user_code = th.from_user_code) AS transferOutTeacher, th.move_at AS transferDate, th.transfer_reason AS reason FROM erp_student_transfer_history th JOIN erp_student es ON th.student_id = es.student_id JOIN erp_teacher_assign t ON es.student_id = t.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON es.grade_key = gc.grade_key WHERE (#{roleKey} = 'ADMIN' OR th.from_user_code = #{userCode}) AND th.center_code = #{centerCode} AND SUBSTRING(th.move_at, 1, 7) = #{ym} ORDER BY es.student_name
